verdict.rationale: doola is a hosted company-formation and compliance service delivered through its Partner API, Embedded SDK, and hosted MCP server. Self-hosting is a fair question to ask of a software platform. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or open-source distribution of the core product; the Embedded SDK and the API both run on 'doola's infrastructure,' so neither is self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
